1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in the adjacency matrix. Forget the second one, and congrats, you've quietly built half a directed graph instead.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 aren't optional extras of each other — they're the same conceptual edge, and gotta go in together, as one pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — just a plain line, 'cause the connection's mutual by nature.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual's showing a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — that mismatch's the bug, mate, and pretty hard to miss.
